reviews.comment: Previously dropped this class w/ a different professor and dreaded this semester but it's now my favorite class! How to be successful: Pay attention in class, take good notes, spend time understanding and working on your homework. I do these things and get A+ on the open-note tests w/o studying at all. He is GREAT but you have to do your part.

AMAZING. While I took an asynchronous course with him, his pre-recorded lectures were great. He only gave quizzes and homework, no exams or final, all of which were very doable. The class itself is a little tough, but Ma makes it very easy to complete and learn. He is also a very understanding grader and responds to emails! Definitely take him!
